name: Pillsbury Grands! Flaky Layers Buttermilk Biscuits (Oven-Baked)
whyItWorks: Baked from refined enriched flour into soft, peelable, buttery layers. The interior crumb is delicate, moist, and low in fiber (1g), melting on the tongue without rough edges.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake in oven or toaster oven at 375°F for 13–15 minutes until golden brown. Drizzle with pure honey or maple syrup.
watchOuts: Soft, refined white dough; chew each bite well.
